description: Card B2's litre-class L-twin: 1099 cc, 90 degrees, redline 11,000.

targets.name: Starts and runs
targets.source: a warm engine started on its key runs (engine.state 2)

targets.name: Within full scale
targets.source: 02-contracts.md, section 1: what process writes is within +-1

targets.name: Holds the limiter
targets.source: a fuel-cut or ignition-cut rev limiter holds the speed within a few percent of where it cuts

targets.name: Peak torque
targets.source: a 1.1 L sport L-twin makes 110 to 125 N m (makers' claims). Reported, not failed: a miss until the engine's breathing and friction at high piston speed are right (card B2's handoff).

targets.name: Peak power
targets.source: a 1.1 L sport L-twin makes 90 to 115 kW (makers' claims for 1100 cc air-and-water-cooled to liquid-cooled sport twins). Reported, not failed: as above.
